items.name: TRANSIENT_LIMITS
items.doc: The legal range of each transient-designer field (engineering units). Every kind comes up flat: no per-kind default differs. the engine's limits generator emits each as `OMX_TRANSIENT_<FIELD>_{MIN,MAX,DEFAULT}` for `mix_transient.h`'s resolve; the row publishes them on OPTIONS when it lands.

items.name: TRANSIENT_FAST_ATTACK_MS
items.doc: The fast follower's attack, ms: exactly the dynamics detector's no-oversampling line.

items.name: TRANSIENT_FAST_RELEASE_MS
items.doc: The fast follower's release, ms: one 50 Hz cycle held, a 180 bpm sixteenth forgotten.

items.name: TRANSIENT_REF_DB
items.doc: The contrast, dB, at which a knob reaches its full value.

items.name: TRANSIENT_FLOOR_LIN
items.doc: The detector floor, linear (−100 dBFS): below it both envelopes read the floor and the stage is unity.
